notes.title: Patch notes 2/2/17
notes.content:
- A variety of optimizations for overall performance improvements.
  - Added multisampling anti-aliasing, transparency supersampling anti-aliasing and anisotropic filtering options.
  - Implemented analog controls for Xinput-compatible gamepads. 
  - Improved 60 FPS mode by fixing simulation time progression rate, speed of many effects and object animations, and the movement speed of NPCs and animals. However, some scripted movements during boss battles might still be sped up or broken, so added a workaround where you can press “F1” to enable a temporary 30 FPS lock in 60 FPS mode.
  - Replaced the game launcher with a new version with many usability improvements.
  - Fixed save game playtime being calculated incorrectly.

A blog with further details of this megapatch will be posted shortly! I'll update these patch notes with the link when it's up.

EDIT: And here's the blog!

http://xseedgames.tumblr.com/post/156725636690/little-kings-story-pc-relaunch-guest-blog

notes.title: 9/20/16 patch notes
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where getting too close to an object makes it unresponsive.
-Fixed a bug where achievements were not unlocked after clearing the game.
-Princess Spumoni’s Gourmet Book can now be completed.
-Fixed various text formatting issues.
 
Thank you for sticking with us every step of the way as we make Little King's Story better!

notes.title: 9/7/16 patch notes
notes.content:
-Added an icon for the exit option
-Fixed a bug that prevented Hardworking Farmers from doing damage
-Mouse now hides while playing
-Fixed various visual bugs

We're still looking into optimizations to improve performance and stability. We'll let you know as soon as we find out more.

Thanks again for sticking with us while we continue to figure things out! Ministers Liam and Verde are on the job!

(Maybe we should get Princess Bouquet in here too...)
